name: Crystalyn R. Danga
status: IT Business Analyst | Software QA Tester
about:
Bachelor of Science in Information Technology at PUP QC, with hands-on experience in Business Analysis, Quality Assurance, and system development. Has taken on multiple roles including Business Analyst, Project Manager, Quality Assurance Tester, Scrum Master, and Backend Developer, contributing to the development of enterprise and academic systems across various domains.

Demonstrates a strong specialization in Quality Assurance, strengthened by active involvement in Business Analysis, system design, and product development. By participating early in requirement gathering, workflow design, and feature planning, brings deeper context into testing—ensuring that systems are validated not only for functionality, but also for usability, logical consistency, and real-world application.

Skilled in translating business requirements into structured workflows, defining clear acceptance criteria, and designing comprehensive test cases that capture both user experience and technical behavior. This approach enables early detection of gaps, improved system design, and delivery of reliable, user-centered solutions.

Possesses a solid technical foundation in full-stack development and system architecture, enabling effective collaboration with developers and a clear understanding of system constraints, edge cases, and implementation details. Experienced in Agile methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog management, and cross-functional coordination to ensure quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle.

Thrives at the intersection of Business Analysis and Quality Assurance—where understanding both user needs and technical systems enables the delivery of scalable, efficient, and high-quality digital solutions.
